codes.name: Master Code
codes.description: Primary master code for Pokémon Emerald US. Add it in Delta as its own cheat and enable it before any other GameShark v3 / Action Replay code.

codes.name: Encounter Master Code
codes.description: Alternate master code that sources pair specifically with encounter-related cheats (Master Ball, wild Pokémon codes). Add as its own cheat and enable it.

codes.name: Walk Through Walls
codes.description: Walk through walls and obstacles. Sources disagree on whether the master code is needed; enabling it costs nothing, so it's listed as required here.
side_effects: Entering restricted areas can glitch or freeze the game — disable when not in use.
Running many cheats at once has been reported to cause random freezes.

codes.name: Rare Candy in PC
codes.description: Fills PC Item Storage with unlimited Rare Candies. Withdraw them at any Pokémon Center PC.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw Item
side_effects: Not reversible: once activated, the PC permanently contains unlimited Rare Candies.

codes.name: Rare Candy at Poké Mart
codes.description: Makes the first Poké Mart slot sell Rare Candies (item ID 044). You still pay with in-game money.
side_effects: Uses the same Mart slot as the Master Ball mart code — enable only one of them at a time.

codes.name: Master Ball at Poké Mart
codes.description: Makes the first Poké Mart slot sell Master Balls (item ID 001). You still pay with in-game money.
side_effects: Uses the same Mart slot as the Rare Candy mart code — enable only one of them at a time.

codes.name: Master Balls in PC
codes.description: Provides Master Balls via PC item storage. Sources pair this with the Encounter Master Code.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw Item

codes.name: Infinite Money
side_effects: The money total may not refresh until you enter a wild battle and run.

codes.name: Shiny Wild Pokémon
codes.description: Forces wild encounters to be shiny.
side_effects: Turn the cheat OFF before actually catching the shiny to avoid name glitches.
Encounter cheats have been associated with 'bad egg' issues — back up your save first.

codes.name: 9,999 EXP per battle
side_effects: Disable once your Pokémon reaches the target level.
Sources disagree on this code's exact line set and grouping — test on a fresh save.
